countries.name: England
countries.description: Explore four popular clubs from English soccer.

clubs.name: Manchester United
introduction: Manchester United is one of the most famous soccer clubs in the world. The club is based in Manchester, England, and plays its home matches at Old Trafford.
The club is known for its red shirts, large worldwide fan base, and long history of success in English and European soccer.
Manchester United has been represented by many legendary players throughout its history, including Bobby Charlton, George Best, Eric Cantona, David Beckham, Wayne Rooney, and Cristiano Ronaldo.
Old Trafford is one of the most recognizable soccer stadiums in England and is often called the Theatre of Dreams.
about: Manchester United was founded in 1878 as Newton Heath LYR Football Club by workers from the Lancashire and Yorkshire Railway.
The club experienced financial problems before being reorganized and renamed Manchester United in 1902.
Manchester United won its first English league championship in 1908 and its first FA Cup in 1909.
Manager Matt Busby later created a talented young team known as the Busby Babes.
Tragedy struck in 1958 when the Munich air disaster resulted in 23 deaths, including eight Manchester United players.
Busby rebuilt the team after the disaster, and Manchester United became the first English club to win the European Cup in 1968.
Another major period of success began after Alex Ferguson became manager in 1986. Under Ferguson, Manchester United became one of the dominant clubs in English soccer.
The club completed a historic Treble in 1999 by winning the Premier League, FA Cup, and UEFA Champions League in the same season.
trophies: 3 European Cup / UEFA Champions League Titles
funFacts: The club was originally named Newton Heath LYR Football Club.
Old Trafford is commonly known as the Theatre of Dreams.
Manchester United became the first English club to win the European Cup in 1968.
The club won the Premier League, FA Cup, and Champions League Treble in 1999.

clubs.name: Manchester City
introduction: Manchester City is a professional soccer club based in Manchester, England.
The club is commonly known as City or the Citizens and is famous for its sky blue home shirts.
Manchester City plays its home matches at the Etihad Stadium, where the club moved in 2003 after leaving Maine Road.
The club has become one of the most successful teams in modern English soccer.
about: Manchester City traces its history to 1880, when the club began as St. Mark's.
The organization later became Ardwick Association Football Club before adopting the Manchester City name in 1894.
City won its first major trophy when it captured the FA Cup in 1904.
The club enjoyed another successful period during the late 1960s and early 1970s.
Manchester City later experienced difficult periods and fell as far as the third level of English soccer during the late 1990s.
A dramatic playoff victory in 1999 helped the club begin its climb back through the English soccer system.
The Abu Dhabi United Group purchased Manchester City in 2008, beginning a new period of major investment and success.
Sergio Aguero scored one of the most famous goals in Premier League history in 2012 when City won the league title in the final moments of the season.
Pep Guardiola became manager in 2016 and developed City into one of Europe's strongest teams.
Manchester City completed a historic Treble during the 2022-23 season by winning the Premier League, FA Cup, and UEFA Champions League.
funFacts: The club began as St. Mark's in 1880.
Sergio Aguero's 2012 title-winning goal is one of the most famous moments in Premier League history.
Manchester City completed the Treble in 2023.
Manchester City and Manchester United compete in the Manchester derby.

clubs.name: Liverpool
introduction: Liverpool Football Club is one of England's most historic and successful soccer clubs.
The club is based in Liverpool, England, and has played its home matches at Anfield since its founding.
Liverpool is famous for its red colors, passionate supporters, and the Kop stand at Anfield.
The song You'll Never Walk Alone has become one of the club's most recognizable traditions.
about: Liverpool was founded in 1892 following a disagreement involving Everton and Anfield owner John Houlding.
The new club began playing at Anfield and quickly established itself in English soccer.
Liverpool won its first English league championship in 1901.
Bill Shankly became manager in 1959 and helped transform Liverpool into a major English and European power.
Managers including Bob Paisley and Joe Fagan continued that success with numerous domestic and European trophies.
The Hillsborough disaster in 1989 resulted in the deaths of 97 Liverpool supporters and remains an important part of the club's history.
Liverpool produced one of the greatest Champions League comebacks in 2005 by recovering from a 3-0 halftime deficit against AC Milan and eventually winning the final.
Under Jurgen Klopp, Liverpool won the Champions League in 2019 and later returned to the top of English soccer.
trophies: 6 European Cup / UEFA Champions League Titles
funFacts: Liverpool has played at Anfield since the club was founded.
You'll Never Walk Alone is strongly associated with Liverpool supporters.
Liverpool came back from 3-0 down in the 2005 Champions League final.
Liverpool and Everton compete in the Merseyside derby.

clubs.name: Arsenal
introduction: Arsenal is one of the most famous soccer clubs in England and is based in North London.
The club is known as the Gunners because of its historical connection to workers at the Royal Arsenal armaments factory.
Arsenal plays its home matches at Emirates Stadium, where the club moved in 2006 after leaving Highbury.
The club has a long history of success and has featured many famous players throughout different generations.
about: Arsenal was founded in 1886 by workers at the Royal Arsenal in Woolwich.
The club used names including Dial Square and Royal Arsenal before eventually becoming Arsenal.
Arsenal moved to Highbury in North London in 1913.
During the 1930s, manager Herbert Chapman helped turn Arsenal into one of England's strongest clubs.
One of Arsenal's most dramatic championships came in 1989 when Michael Thomas scored a late goal against Liverpool at Anfield to secure the league title.
Arsene Wenger became manager in 1996 and changed the club through new training methods, tactics, and an attacking style of soccer.
The 2003-04 Arsenal team completed the entire Premier League season without losing a match, earning the nickname the Invincibles.
Arsenal moved from Highbury to Emirates Stadium in 2006.
ballonDor: No men's Ballon d'Or winner while representing Arsenal.
funFacts: Arsenal's Gunners nickname comes from the club's connection to an armaments factory.
Arsenal completed the 2003-04 Premier League season without losing a match.
Arsenal has won a record 14 FA Cups.
Arsenal and Tottenham compete in the North London derby.
A statue of Thierry Henry stands outside Emirates Stadium.

countries.name: Spain
countries.description: Discover four popular clubs from Spanish soccer.

clubs.name: Real Madrid
introduction: Real Madrid is one of the most successful and recognizable soccer clubs in the world.
The club is based in Madrid, Spain, and is famous for its traditional all-white uniform.
Real Madrid plays its home matches at the Santiago Bernabeu, one of the most famous stadiums in European soccer.
The club has built its reputation through domestic success, European championships, and generations of world-famous players.
about: Real Madrid was officially founded in 1902 and quickly became an important club in Spanish soccer.
The club received the royal title Real from King Alfonso XIII in 1920.
Real Madrid became especially powerful during the 1950s, when stars such as Alfredo Di Stefano helped the club dominate European competition.
The club won the first five editions of the European Cup from 1956 through 1960.
Real Madrid has continued to attract many of the world's best players throughout its history.
The Galacticos era featured stars such as Luis Figo, Zinedine Zidane, Ronaldo Nazario, David Beckham, and Roberto Carlos.
Cristiano Ronaldo later became the club's all-time leading scorer while helping Real Madrid win multiple Champions League titles.
Real Madrid remains closely associated with success in the UEFA Champions League.
trophies: 15 European Cup / UEFA Champions League Titles
funFacts: Real Madrid traditionally plays in an all-white home uniform.
The club won the first five European Cups.
Real Madrid and Barcelona compete in El Clasico.
Cristiano Ronaldo became the club's all-time leading scorer.
The Santiago Bernabeu is named after a former Real Madrid player and president.

clubs.name: Barcelona
introduction: FC Barcelona is one of the most famous soccer clubs in Spain and the world.
The club is based in Barcelona, Catalonia, and is known for its blue and garnet colors.
Barcelona has become famous for technical, possession-based soccer and for developing talented players through its youth system.
The club's motto, Mes que un club, means More than a club.
about: Barcelona was founded in 1899 by a group led by Joan Gamper.
The club became closely connected with Catalan culture and identity.
Barcelona developed one of soccer's most famous youth academies, commonly known as La Masia.
Players including Lionel Messi, Xavi, Andres Iniesta, Sergio Busquets, and Carles Puyol developed through Barcelona's system.
Johan Cruyff had an enormous influence on Barcelona as both a player and a manager.
Pep Guardiola later built one of the most successful teams in soccer history around possession, movement, and pressing.
Barcelona won six major trophies during the 2009 calendar year.
Lionel Messi became the club's all-time leading scorer and one of the greatest players in the history of the sport.
funFacts: Barcelona's motto is Mes que un club, meaning More than a club.
La Masia has produced many famous players.
Lionel Messi scored 672 goals for Barcelona.
Barcelona and Real Madrid compete in El Clasico.
The club's supporters are often called Culers.

clubs.name: Atletico Madrid
introduction: Atletico Madrid is one of Spain's most successful and recognizable soccer clubs.
The club is based in Madrid and is famous for its red-and-white striped shirts.
Atletico has developed a reputation for determination, strong defending, and passionate supporters.
The club plays its home matches at the Metropolitano Stadium.
about: Atletico Madrid was founded in 1903.
The club developed into one of the major teams in Spanish soccer and has won league and cup championships throughout its history.
Atletico has traditionally competed with Real Madrid in the Madrid derby.
The club played for many years at the Vicente Calderon Stadium before moving to its current stadium.
Diego Simeone became manager in 2011 and helped establish a highly competitive identity built around organization and teamwork.
Under Simeone, Atletico won La Liga, the Europa League, and other major trophies.
The club also reached multiple UEFA Champions League finals during this period.
Players such as Fernando Torres, Diego Godin, Antoine Griezmann, and Koke became strongly associated with modern Atletico Madrid.
ballonDor: No men's Ballon d'Or winner while representing Atletico Madrid.
funFacts: Atletico is commonly nicknamed Los Colchoneros.
The club competes against Real Madrid in the Madrid derby.
Atletico played at the Vicente Calderon before moving to the Metropolitano.
Red and white stripes are a major part of the club's identity.

clubs.name: Athletic Bilbao
introduction: Athletic Bilbao is a historic Spanish soccer club based in Bilbao in the Basque Country.
The club is famous for its red-and-white striped shirts and strong regional identity.
Athletic plays its home matches at San Mames.
The club is especially well known for its unique tradition of developing and fielding players connected to the Basque region.
about: Athletic Bilbao was founded in 1898 and became one of the early major clubs in Spanish soccer.
The club has a strong connection to Basque culture and identity.
Athletic is famous for its player policy centered on footballers developed in or connected with the Basque soccer system.
Despite this distinctive approach, Athletic has remained competitive at the highest level of Spanish soccer.
Athletic is one of the traditional clubs that has never been relegated from Spain's top division.
The club has enjoyed particular success in the Copa del Rey.
Historic players such as Telmo Zarra became major figures in Spanish soccer while representing Athletic.
San Mames and Athletic's passionate supporters are important parts of the club's identity.
ballonDor: No men's Ballon d'Or winner while representing Athletic Bilbao.
funFacts: Athletic has a famous policy centered on players connected to the Basque region.
The club has never been relegated from Spain's top division.
San Mames is sometimes called the Cathedral of soccer.
Telmo Zarra is one of the most famous players in the club's history.

countries.name: Germany
countries.description: Explore four popular clubs from German soccer.

clubs.name: Bayern Munich
introduction: Bayern Munich is the most successful soccer club in Germany and one of the most successful clubs in Europe.
The club is based in Munich, Bavaria, and is famous for its red colors.
Bayern plays its home matches at the Allianz Arena, a stadium known for its distinctive illuminated exterior.
The club has featured many of Germany's greatest players and has regularly competed for major European trophies.
about: Bayern Munich was founded in 1900.
The club developed into a major force in German soccer during the twentieth century.
Bayern's rise to international prominence accelerated during the 1960s and 1970s.
Franz Beckenbauer, Gerd Muller, and Sepp Maier formed the core of a team that achieved major domestic and European success.
Bayern won three consecutive European Cups during the 1970s.
The club has continued to dominate German soccer during the Bundesliga era.
Bayern completed a Treble in 2013 by winning the Bundesliga, DFB-Pokal, and UEFA Champions League.
The club completed another Treble in 2020.
trophies: 6 European Cup / UEFA Champions League Titles
funFacts: Bayern is Germany's most successful soccer club.
The Allianz Arena can illuminate its exterior.
Bayern won three consecutive European Cups during the 1970s.
The club completed continental Trebles in both 2013 and 2020.

clubs.name: Borussia Dortmund
introduction: Borussia Dortmund is one of Germany's best-known soccer clubs.
The club is based in Dortmund and is famous for its black-and-yellow colors.
Dortmund plays at Signal Iduna Park, which is known for its large crowds and intense atmosphere.
The club has developed a reputation for passionate supporters and talented young players.
about: Borussia Dortmund was founded in 1909.
The club became an important force in German soccer and won multiple national championships.
Dortmund enjoyed a particularly successful period during the 1990s.
The club won the UEFA Champions League in 1997.
Financial difficulties created major challenges for Dortmund during the early 2000s.
The club recovered and returned to major success under manager Jurgen Klopp.
Dortmund won consecutive Bundesliga titles in 2011 and 2012.
The club's Yellow Wall has become one of the most recognizable supporter sections in world soccer.
funFacts: Borussia Dortmund was founded in 1909.
The club's colors are black and yellow.
The Yellow Wall is one of Europe's most famous supporter sections.
Dortmund won the Champions League in 1997.

clubs.name: VfB Stuttgart
introduction: VfB Stuttgart is a historic German soccer club based in Stuttgart.
The club is recognizable for its white shirts with a red chest band.
Stuttgart plays its home matches at the MHPArena.
The club has won major German championships and has a strong tradition of developing talented players.
about: VfB Stuttgart traces its history to 1893.
The club developed into one of the important teams in southern Germany.
Stuttgart has won multiple German national championships throughout its history.
The club became one of the founding members of the Bundesliga in 1963.
Stuttgart won the Bundesliga during the 1983-84 season.
The club won another Bundesliga championship in 1992.
A young Stuttgart squad captured the Bundesliga title again during the 2006-07 season.
The club is also known for a youth development system that has produced numerous professional players.
ballonDor: No men's Ballon d'Or winner while representing VfB Stuttgart.
funFacts: Stuttgart is famous for the red chest band on its home shirt.
The club was a founding member of the Bundesliga.
Stuttgart won the Bundesliga in 2007 with a relatively young team.
The club has a strong youth development tradition.

clubs.name: Borussia Monchengladbach
introduction: Borussia Monchengladbach is a historic German soccer club based in Monchengladbach.
The club is commonly known as Gladbach and has a strong tradition in German soccer.
Borussia plays its home matches at Borussia-Park.
The club is especially remembered for its highly successful teams of the 1970s.
about: Borussia Monchengladbach was founded in 1900.
The club rose to national prominence during the 1960s.
Gladbach became one of Germany's dominant clubs during the 1970s.
The team became known for fast and attacking soccer.
Players such as Gunter Netzer, Jupp Heynckes, and Berti Vogts became important figures in the club's history.
Gladbach won five Bundesliga championships during its most successful era.
The club also achieved success in European competition by winning two UEFA Cups.
Borussia Monchengladbach continues to have a passionate fan base and an important place in Bundesliga history.
funFacts: Gladbach won five Bundesliga titles during the 1970s.
The club became famous for attacking soccer.
Borussia-Park opened in 2004.
Jupp Heynckes became a legendary figure for the club as a player.

countries.name: Italy
countries.description: Discover four popular clubs from Italian soccer.

clubs.name: Juventus
introduction: Juventus is one of Italy's most successful and recognizable soccer clubs.
The club is based in Turin and is famous for its black-and-white striped shirts.
Juventus plays its home matches at Allianz Stadium.
The club has a long history of domestic success and has featured many of the greatest players in Italian and international soccer.
about: Juventus was founded in 1897 by a group of students in Turin.
The club developed into one of the strongest teams in Italian soccer.
Juventus has won more Italian league championships than any other Italian club.
The Agnelli family became closely associated with Juventus beginning in the 1920s.
The club has featured famous players including Giampiero Boniperti, Michel Platini, Roberto Baggio, Alessandro Del Piero, Gianluigi Buffon, and Cristiano Ronaldo.
Juventus has also enjoyed success in European competition.
Alessandro Del Piero became one of the greatest symbols of the club during a long career in Turin.
Juventus moved into its modern stadium in 2011.
trophies: 2 European Cup / UEFA Champions League Titles
funFacts: Juventus was founded by students in Turin.
The club is commonly known as the Old Lady.
Juventus is famous for its black-and-white striped shirts.
Alessandro Del Piero is the club's all-time leading scorer.

clubs.name: Inter Milan
introduction: Inter Milan is one of Italy's most famous and successful soccer clubs.
The club is based in Milan and is known for its black-and-blue striped shirts.
Inter shares the San Siro stadium with city rival AC Milan.
The club has achieved major success in both Italian and European competition.
about: Inter Milan was founded in 1908.
The club's full name reflects its original goal of welcoming international players.
Inter quickly became an important team in Italian soccer.
The club enjoyed major European success during the 1960s under manager Helenio Herrera.
That team became known as Grande Inter and won consecutive European Cups.
Inter has featured famous players including Giuseppe Meazza, Javier Zanetti, Ronaldo Nazario, and many others.
Jose Mourinho led Inter to a historic Treble in 2010.
Inter won Serie A, the Coppa Italia, and UEFA Champions League during that season.
trophies: 3 European Cup / UEFA Champions League Titles
funFacts: Inter has never been relegated from Italy's top division.
Inter shares San Siro with AC Milan.
The stadium is also officially named after Giuseppe Meazza.
Inter completed a historic Treble in 2010.

clubs.name: AC Milan
introduction: AC Milan is one of Italy's most historic and successful soccer clubs.
The club is based in Milan and is famous for its red-and-black striped shirts.
AC Milan shares the San Siro stadium with city rival Inter Milan.
The club has a particularly strong history in European competition.
about: AC Milan was founded in 1899.
The club developed into one of Italy's major soccer institutions.
Milan has featured legendary players from Italy and around the world.
The late 1980s and early 1990s were an especially famous period under manager Arrigo Sacchi.
Dutch stars Ruud Gullit, Marco van Basten, and Frank Rijkaard helped form one of the strongest teams of the era.
Milan continued to enjoy European success under managers such as Fabio Capello and Carlo Ancelotti.
Players including Paolo Maldini, Franco Baresi, Kaka, Andriy Shevchenko, and Andrea Pirlo became strongly associated with the club.
AC Milan's seven European Cup and Champions League titles place it among Europe's most successful clubs.
trophies: 7 European Cup / UEFA Champions League Titles
funFacts: AC Milan is known as the Rossoneri, meaning the Red and Blacks.
Milan shares San Siro with Inter Milan.
Paolo Maldini spent his entire senior club career with Milan.
AC Milan has won seven European Cup and Champions League titles.

clubs.name: Genoa
introduction: Genoa Cricket and Football Club is one of the oldest and most historic soccer clubs in Italy.
The club is based in the port city of Genoa and is known for its red-and-blue colors.
Genoa plays its home matches at Stadio Luigi Ferraris.
Although much of Genoa's greatest success came during the early history of Italian soccer, the club remains an important part of the country's soccer tradition.
about: Genoa was founded in 1893 and is considered the oldest existing soccer club in Italy.
The organization originally included cricket before soccer became its most famous sport.
Genoa played an important role in the earliest years of organized Italian soccer.
The club won the first Italian soccer championship in 1898.
Genoa dominated the early period of Italian soccer and won six of the first seven national championships.
The club eventually accumulated nine Italian league championships.
Genoa's traditional symbol is the griffin.
The club shares Stadio Luigi Ferraris with local rival Sampdoria.
Matches between Genoa and Sampdoria are known as the Derby della Lanterna.
ballonDor: No men's Ballon d'Or winner while representing Genoa.
funFacts: Genoa is considered the oldest existing soccer club in Italy.
The club won the first Italian championship in 1898.
Genoa won six of the first seven Italian championships.
The club's symbol is a griffin.
Genoa and Sampdoria compete in the Derby della Lanterna.
